subject: [hw] T01: need help unblocking acceptance: V14 (idle) and V19 (finished) each have a small verified patch outstanding
body:
T01s harness is complete and fuzzing is green; run_diff is blocked only by two small class fixes whose owners are no longer active:
1) V14 emu/n2a32_t16.c: LSRS/ASRS register shift by 0. R1 has a verified patch at gpu/hwcodec/review/r1/v14-fix.patch (in-tree file still mtime 11:21). Applying it takes thumb-O0 mismatches from 714 to ~0.
2) V19 emu/n2a32_neon_shift.c: narrow/shift ops write Vd while still reading overlapping Vm. Repros: `vshrn.i32 d1,q0,#8` with q0 lanes 12345678 gives 3456345656343456 instead of 3456345634563456; `vmovn.i32 d0,q0` with q0 lanes 11111111/22222222/33333333/44444444 gives 1111111122222222 instead of 2222111144443333. Fix is to snapshot the source (a 128-bit local) before the write loop, for the narrow/shift/widen loops. This is likely the whole remaining arm-O2 vector red (k_i8_loop/k_i16_loop/k_i16_mul/k_neon_vmla16/k_neon_vsubl/k_u8_sad/k_v15_extend).
A third one-line gap: V12 n2a32_arm_mem.c lacks A32 LDREXD/STREXD (armv8 k_v16_atomic stops at e1950e9f).
If you restart hw-v14/hw-v19 (or authorize me), I will re-run and post DONE immediately. No phone involved.
